candidate.change: vLLM V1 KV-offload adds an optional KVCR-backed SecondaryTierManager with router-hint and NIXL-backed external cache transport integration.

dependencyBinding.binding: The observed vLLM integration installs KVCR by exact v0.1.0 git tag. Evaluation may not float KVCR main.
dependencyBinding.nixlRequirement: Record the exact installed NIXL package/version and CUDA-family wheel in each execution receipt.

deduplication.estateSearch: No existing KVCR integration wave, issue, pull request, or code reference was found in the connected szl-holdings estate before intake.

requiredEvidence: Bind execution to vllm-project/vllm@000c7df9ffd3e470980fd4cd6b8ec1b0585500ff and ai-dynamo/kvcr v0.1.0 at peeled commit 1b790eff53edcdc6398121b6e6ee48ba43cf2579; later source revisions inherit no qualification automatically.
Record exact vLLM source or container digest, KVCR source/tag, NIXL package, CUDA runtime, driver, PyTorch, accelerator, transport/backend configuration and test fixture identity.
Prove the optional-dependency negative control: KVCR absence makes the kvcr tier explicitly unavailable without changing incumbent non-KVCR behavior.
Prove byte-for-byte block correctness for put, lookup, offload and fetch before comparing model output against the same exact runtime with KVCR disabled.

Exercise exact-key hit, miss, partial remote hit, repeated miss, mixed local/remote availability, block ordering, supported multi-block or multi-pool layouts, eviction pressure, pin/release, saturation and cleanup.

Exercise timeout before transport submission, timeout after submission, cancellation, late completion, source or target failure, remote-write uncertainty, Guard-confirmed source death, quarantine or tombstone cleanup, worker restart and shutdown; stale or cross-request KV must never become readable.
Prove request, session and tenant isolation plus key-collision negative controls; router hints are cache-location evidence and never provider, model, tenant, policy or tool authority.

Prove rollback to the incumbent exact model/runtime/protocol path when KVCR is disabled; any fallback that changes model bytes, tokenizer/protocol, provider authority, quantization or policy must fail closed.

Measure transfer latency, cache-hit behavior, TTFT, ITL, throughput and host/device memory only after correctness and failure gates pass; upstream performance claims remain upstream-reported until reproduced.
Record upstream and transitive license/provenance obligations for KVCR, NIXL and the evaluated runtime closure before any promotion.
